title: fix: mobile pairing loses the Control UI base path
body:
Closes #161617

## What Problem This Solves

When a Gateway uses `gateway.controlUi.basePath`, an origin-only pairing URL sends the mobile embedded Settings page to `/settings` instead of its configured mount. New QR and Gateway pairing setup codes now include that mount.

The shared setup-code resolver owns the configured `device-pair.publicUrl` fallback and applies the normalized mount only when the selected URL has no path. Explicit CLI/RPC overrides, configured URLs that already contain a path, and remote Gateway URLs remain authoritative. This removes duplicated fallback selection from the CLI and RPC callers. Existing pairings are unchanged; generate a new setup code and re-pair to update their endpoint.

## Evidence

Maintainer validation used candidate `9878b079844915a1bf7947a8ed721292b797d14b` on main `99567a65b7c5912d27339a699bc3d315a113d254`. The original contributor patch is unchanged by the rebase.

Paired builds used isolated HOME/configuration/state, fresh ports, and synthetic credentials. Only sanitized results were retained:

| Real flow | Baseline | Candidate |
|---|---|---|
| Built `openclaw qr --json`, local mount | Origin-only | `/gateway` |
| Configured public origin | `wss://pair.example` | `wss://pair.example/gateway` |
| Production Swift setup-code decoder compiled on macOS | Empty context path | `/gateway` |
| Settings route selected from the decoded endpoint | HTTP **404** at `/settings` | HTTP **200** at `/gateway/settings` |
| Bootstrap connection to the newly booted Gateway | Node credentials + operator handoff | Same credentials/roles, authenticated at `/gateway` |

Configured `/proxy`, explicit origin/path overrides, remote `/remote`, and no-base-path controls retain their URLs. Real `device.pair.setupCode` RPC calls also preserve explicit override labeling and emit join URLs under `/gateway/j/…`.

- **Red → green:** six shared-resolver regressions fail against main production code (52 cases still pass; the runner then stops). Candidate: **126/126** across the five focused resolver, public-origin, trusted-proxy, QR, and pairing-RPC files.
- **Sibling coverage:** cloud node enrollment **40/40**; private-completion **23/23**, including both terminal orderings of the original CI failure.
- **Builds:** baseline and candidate `cliStartup` builds pass. Live paired builds/probes use Node 26.10.0; the CI regression and sibling suite use Node 24.19.0.
- Canonical autoreview reports `scoped-clean` at its P0 threshold; hands-on source/owner/sibling review found no actionable defect.
- Complete six-file `check-changed` passes on **Node 24.19.0** (880.26s): core typecheck, all 27 affected test type graphs, typed lint (0 warnings/errors), formatting, all three Knip scans (0 entries), and all selected source/security/storage guards. No checks were skipped. The unchanged source-scan subprocess crashed with SIGILL on local Node 26.10.0 before this successful supported-runtime run.

The old CI failure in `checks-node-changed-compact-large-29-3` was a session-generation ownership failure during subagent cancellation. Rebasing includes the existing owner repair [fef7992b3697](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fef7992b3697b5f56a3f469ec951ec210b8918b4); the failing file now passes without increasing timeouts or weakening assertions.

Production delta: **+17/-13 (net +4)**; tests: **+94/-6 (net +88)**. The small production growth expresses the explicit/configured/remote URL distinction after removing duplicated caller policy. No new configuration key, default, schema, migration, dependency, native-app code, or authentication contract.

The same missing mount is present in stable `v2026.9.7` and pinned main. The `/pair` plugin's separately documented origin-only behavior remains unchanged.

**Proof limits:** the real Gateway served a fixture static index to isolate mount routing. No full Control UI rendering, physical mobile re-pairing, live external proxy/Tailscale deployment, complete native app run, or full release/package build is claimed. Existing resolver tests cover Tailscale/public-origin and trusted-proxy contracts. No production deployment or restart was performed.

AI-assisted implementation and review. Original contributor [sanitized session log and proof](https://gist.github.com/Marvinthebored/15ea7cf8012fd075d4e3a3c33b7ff374) are retained. Maintainer paired proof has immutable source/output hashes; its manifest SHA256 is `f0f1c75b510d715f97007b6cfc5c71e418e4c3d79d4c3d39c0d05a8184cb7167`.
